name: treatment
description: A/B test arm: control vs variant; uniformly assigned

name: region
description: Geographic region (north, south, east, west) with planted mean-revenue differences for ANOVA examples

name: segment
description: User segment (segment_a, segment_b, segment_c) with planted conversion-rate differences for chi-square examples

name: converted
description: Conversion outcome: yes / no; rates depend on segment (independent of region by construction)

name: revenue_before
description: Pre-treatment baseline revenue for each unit; log-normal base × region lift only (no treatment lift, no time drift) — pairs row-wise with revenue for paired tests

name: revenue
description: Order revenue in USD; log-normal base with region and treatment lifts plus a mild upward drift over period

name: session_minutes
description: Session duration; half-normal distribution shifted slightly under variant treatment

name: period
description: Day the unit was recorded; 90 consecutive days starting 2026-01-01 — supports trend tests
